title: biomes.craters/1
description: data/biomes/craters.json: a slam's crater by material (docs/world/craters-by-material.md; WorldCraters), Combat's numbers from docs/combat/biomes.md section 4.3. Version field: schema. Policy: every top-level key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore; in a class row radius, depth, rim, steep, cracks and ejecta are required and the rest optional (absent: no refill, no embed factor, no water, no break). Cross-checks (each class is one of WorldGround.LOOKS; refill and refillTicks come together; seaCols only with fill waterNearSea) are WorldCraters' own load and craters_check.

enabled.description: The whole module: contact.gd's slam digs the material's bowl. Off by default.

touchBuilt.description: The rows of the five built classes (paving, rock, soil, sand, rubble) apply only with this on.

embedThresholdScales.description: An embed's threshold is multiplied by the row's depth, so the embed rate is today's on every surface (Game Design, rulings 2026-10-23b item 3).

classes.description: One row per look class (WorldGround.LOOKS); a class without a row digs today's bowl.

depth.description: Times today's bowl depth (and its relief cap).

steep.description: The bowl wall's shape: 1 is today's; above 1 a flatter floor and steeper walls, below 1 a slacker bowl.

refill.description: The share of the bowl's depth that fills back.

refillTicks.description: Over this many ticks (60 a second).

embedMul.description: How deep an embedded body sits, times the bowl's depth: a look, not a rate.

fill.description: Water stands in the bowl: to the biome's water table (water), or to the sea where open water is within seaCols (waterNearSea).

breakThrough.description: On sea ice, a bowl whose floor reaches below the sea breaks the floe and opens water under him.

rimKind.description: What the rim is made of, for the look (the event only).

treesLean.description: Trees within this many radii lean outward (the event only).

glowTicks.description: How long the bowl glows (the event only).
